pr.body:
## Summary
Complete renaming of the project from `cmdai` to `caro` across all documentation, configuration, and code files.

## Changes Made

### Documentation & Config (~130 files)
- ✅ GitHub files (issue templates, workflows, PR template)
- ✅ Presentation files (package.json, slides.md, READMEs)
- ✅ Root docs (README.md, CLAUDE.md, SECURITY.md)
- ✅ docs/ directory (setup guides, ADRs, implementation logs)
- ✅ specs/ directory (spec files, plans, contracts, quickstarts)
- ✅ Configuration files (rustfmt, deny, clippy, nextest)
- ✅ Agent descriptions (.claude/agents/)
- ✅ Constitution (.specify/memory/constitution.md)

### Code Changes
- ✅ Renamed variable `cmdai_cache` → `caro_cache` in src/model_loader.rs
- ✅ Environment variables: `CMDAI_*` → `CARO_*`
- ✅ Config paths: `~/.config/cmdai/` → `~/.config/caro/`
- ✅ GitHub URLs: `github.com/wildcard/cmdai` → `github.com/wildcard/caro`
- ✅ Package name: `cmdai-presentation` → `caro-presentation`

### Preserved
- ✅ Historical references in `docs/NAMING_HISTORY.md` remain unchanged
- ✅ Historical context notes like "formerly cmdai" preserved in key docs

## Testing
- ✅ All 73 cargo tests pass
- ✅ Verified no cmdai references remain (except NAMING_HISTORY.md)
- ✅ Build succeeds

## Verification
```bash
# Confirm only NAMING_HISTORY.md contains cmdai
rg -i "cmdai" --type md --type yml --type json --type rs | grep -v NAMING_HISTORY

# All tests pass
cargo test --lib
```

docs: Rename all cmdai references to caro across codebase

Complete renaming of the project from cmdai to caro across all
documentation, configuration, and code files.

- Updated all references in .github/ (issue templates, workflows, PRs)
- Updated presentation files (package.json, slides.md, READMEs)
- Updated root documentation (README.md, CLAUDE.md, SECURITY.md)
- Updated docs/ directory (~25 files with setup guides, ADRs, sessions)
- Updated specs/ directory (~30 spec files, plans, contracts)
- Updated configuration files (rustfmt, deny, clippy, nextest)
- Updated .claude/agents/ (8 agent description files)
- Updated .specify/memory/constitution.md
- Renamed variable caro_cache in src/model_loader.rs (was cmdai_cache)
- Updated environment variable references (CMDAI_* → CARO_*)
- Updated config paths (~/.config/cmdai/ → ~/.config/caro/)
- Updated GitHub URLs (github.com/wildcard/cmdai → github.com/wildcard/caro)

Preserved:
- Historical references in docs/NAMING_HISTORY.md remain unchanged
- Rust crate already renamed to "caro" in previous commits

- Historical context preserved ("formerly cmdai" notes in docs)
